name: Fallout 4
description: Wander the Commonwealth together. F4MP adds multiplayer to Fallout 4 through the Fallout 4 Script Extender: every player appears in the others' world, and in this fork they fight the same enemies. Experimental: expect bugs, and back up your saves.

setup.title: Fallout 4
setup.detail: Install Fallout 4 from your Steam library.

Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in the game's Data folder. Cairn then installs F4SE, switches the mod's plugin on and enables loose files by itself (see the setup list). Fallout 4 must be on version 1.10.163.

hostSteps: Put Fallout 4 on version 1.10.163, the classic build from before the Next-Gen update (the setup list tells you if it is not). Then download the mod above and let Cairn finish the setup list.
Press Play: Cairn starts the game through F4SE. Load a save.
In the game press F5 to host a Steam co-op lobby, or F1 to play by direct IP against a running F4MP server (the server is in the mod's folder in Cairn).
Your Steam friends who have the same mod version join with F6.
joinSteps: Put Fallout 4 on version 1.10.163, download the mod above (the same version as the host's) and let Cairn finish the setup list.
Press Play and load a save of your own.
In the game press F6 to join the Steam co-op lobby of your friend, or F1 to join a server by IP.
Everyone keeps their own save: the mod shows each player in the others' world and shares the fights.

items.name: Steam co-op
items.detail: One player hosts a lobby (F5), friends join it (F6). Everyone needs the same game version, F4SE and mod version.

items.name: Direct IP
items.detail: Join a running F4MP server by address (F1).

items.name: Set up by Cairn
items.detail: Cairn checks the game version, installs F4SE (checked against a pinned file), switches the plugin on and enables loose files, and keeps the mod up to date.

items.name: Players in each other's world
items.detail: Each player's appearance, position and animations are shown to the others.

items.name: Shared combat
items.detail: Enemies take damage and die for every player: a hit on an enemy another player owns is routed to them.

items.name: Shared progression
items.detail: Quests, loot and settlements are still each player's own.
